name: Carried Cold
source:
A violent snowstorm has suddenly appeared, effecting a specific mountain and the area surrounding it. A storm like this certainly couldn't have appeared through natural circumstances.

Witness a mountain inhabitant's journey to reach the peak, while carrying two of his incapacitated family members in tow.

Once he reaches there, everything will finally be ok again; It has to.

[From [url=https://crushcat.itch.io/carried-cold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场猛烈的暴风雪突然出现，影响了一座特定的山脉及其周围地区。像这样的风暴当然不可能是自然条件下出现的。

见证一位山区居民带着两名失去行动能力的家人登上山顶的旅程。

一旦他到达那里，一切都会恢复正常；必须如此。

[来自[url=https://crushcat.itch.io/carried-cold]Itch.io[/url]]
